reuse.deja_query: BVB descriptor set lease queue pool layout reset epoch batch preallocation E131
local_contracts: E121 authoritative descriptor-pool reset and child retirement
E130 active handoff and synchronous native-result boundary

implementation.learning: The Bionic worker records only successful real allocation call shapes for up to 512 sets per tracked pool.
implementation.refill: After a successful native pool reset, Bionic repeats the learned call boundaries against the reset native pool and publishes the typed IDs only after every call succeeds.
implementation.claim: The glibc client validates pool and layout IDs against the immutable reset-epoch bank, advances one bounded cursor under its global Vulkan lock, and registers the returned typed proxies locally.

correctness.reset: The service disables the old bank before reset; native reset retires all old typed set IDs before any new epoch is published.
correctness.destroy: Successful descriptor-pool destruction disables its bank and forgets its learned plan.
correctness.journal_order: A lease hit is a completed allocation whose native work occurred at reset. Pending descriptor writes remain ordered in the existing journal and are drained before the next real bridge operation.
correctness.native_failure: A refill allocation failure is cleared with a second authoritative native reset; no lease is published and later calls use the real synchronous path.
correctness.mismatch: A layout mismatch never returns the wrong lease and falls back to E130. The worker disables the remaining bank and learns again after the next reset.
correctness.bounded_caveat: If a layout mismatch occurs after some leases were consumed, unused prefetched native sets remain allocated until the next pool reset. The optimization is opt-in through shared descriptor mode; strict mode remains the semantic control.

validation.lease_unit_sequence: publish three; claim two; reject mismatch without cursor movement; claim final; disable
validation.cross_process: one real allocation learns; real reset preallocates; the next identical allocation returns a typed proxy with zero socket exchanges and zero ring calls

next_gate: Build and run the exact E131 pair on the tablet. Measure lease hit rate, remaining ring transactions, reset refill stalls, frame blocking, and the game-authored benchmark before claiming a speedup.
